::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Sept 5th [1868]  
**From:** Elderfield, Otterbourne, Winchester.  
**Manuscript:** MS British Library Add MSS 54920: 208-9
:::

My dear [Mr Craik](people/person_379.qmd),
I am dismayed at what I never found out till the [Saturday Review](organizations/other_99.qmd) called my attention to it - ie that the [Cameo](cmy_books/cmybook_73.qmd) about the conquest of Wales was left out.

Such a Cameo there was written, it is at Vol IV p. 6 of the [Monthly Packet](organizations/other_52.qmd), but it must have been neglected when I was collecting the Cameos and the printing was done so very slowly that I lost the connection, and so did not miss it. I am very sorry for it, but it must go in whenever there is a new edition - or would it be possible to add it as a kind of appendix to the copies not yet bound. I suppose it would make about 8pp. The name is the Last & first Princes of Wales

Yours sincerely
C M Yonge
